description: MainActivity.kt defines the main UI and game logic for a Tic Tac Toe Android application, including user interactions, game state management, and UI updates.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class managing Tic Tac Toe game UI and interactions.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, binds views, sets up listeners, and updates UI.

methods.name: bindViews
methods.description: Binds UI components to class properties using findViewById.

methods.name: setupBoardListeners
methods.description: Sets click listeners for each game tile.

methods.name: onTileTapped
methods.description: Handles user tapping a tile, updates game state, checks for win/draw, and updates UI accordingly.

methods.name: togglePlayer
methods.description: Switches the current player between 'X' and 'O'.

methods.name: onWin
methods.description: Handles game win scenario, updates scores, highlights winning line, and updates status message.

methods.name: onDraw
methods.description: Handles draw scenario, updates status message.

methods.name: updateStatus
methods.description: Updates the status text view with the current turn information.

methods.name: updateScores
methods.description: Updates the score displays for X and O.

methods.name: resetGame
methods.description: Resets the game board for a new game while maintaining scores.

methods.name: getColorCompat
methods.description: Retrieves color resource considering Android version compatibility.

methods.name: checkWin
methods.description: Checks if the specified player has a winning line.

methods.name: findWinningLine
methods.description: Finds and returns the line indices that constitutes the current player's winning line.

methods.name: highlightWinningLine
methods.description: Highlights the tiles in the winning line.

methods.name: playerIcon
methods.description: Returns the display icon for a player.

methods.name: playerColor
methods.description: Returns the color associated with a player.
